postings.title: Staff Brand Designer, Graphic & Web
postings.description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.




THE OPPORTUNITY

The SandboxAQ Design team is one unified organization spanning brand, creative, and product, with designers embedded day-to-day in the Business Units they support. We are a lean, hands-on team, every designer here owns their work day to day, from strategy through execution. This role is our first dedicated hire for brand and visual design.

We are looking for a Staff Brand Designer to join our central Design team, reporting to the VP of Design. You will craft the vision of how SandboxAQ shows up, and execute it across mediums for a company whose work spans life sciences, chemistry, financial services, navigation, AI operations and cybersecurity. What makes this both hard and exciting: there is no brand practice to inherit and no team to delegate to; the vision gets built through the work.

In this role, you will:

 - Set the creative direction for the SandboxAQ brand, and prove it in the work.

 - Shape a cohesive parent brand and supporting assets across six domains. Life sciences, chemistry, financial services, navigation, AI operations and cybersecurity each deserve a visual expression of their own, but must still stand together as SandboxAQ.

 - Own sandboxaq.com http://sandboxaq.com: design, build, ship, and maintain it, hands-on in the CMS.

 - Create scalable solutions: Templates, kits, systems, and AI-assisted workflows that enable our team to scale beyond its size.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and evolve the SandboxAQ brand. Set the creative vision and build the design system — visual identity, components, guidelines, and the brand architecture for our sub-brands. You will be the most senior voice on brand at the company. We expect you to have a point of view, to be able to defend it, and to change our minds.

 - Own the corporate web presence end to end. Design, build, and maintain sandboxaq.com http://sandboxaq.com and related properties (currently Webflow). You are the point of contact for corporate web, working directly in the CMS rather than handing specs to someone else.

 - Produce high-craft work yourself. Conference and event graphics, brochures, one-pagers, infographics, executive and go-to-market materials. You’ll handle a steady stream of hands-on design work for our team. It is also the fastest route to moving the brand somewhere new, so we want someone who treats each piece as a chance to push the system rather than a ticket to close.

 - Build scalable design processes and resources. Deck templates, brand kits, asset libraries, and repeatable processes that let people across the company self-serve high-quality work without routing through you.

 - Partner across the company, and direct outside help when needed. Work with product designers, creative media, marketing, and go-to-market as a design partner brought in early to shape the problem, not a service desk taking requests at the end. Brief external partners and hold the standard on overflow or specialist work.




ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - ~8+ years crafting brand systems, graphic design, and web design.

 - Hands-on fluency with a modern CMS or visual web platform (Webflow, HTML/CSS), with the ability to take a site from design through build, launch, and ongoing maintenance yourself.

 - Proven experience building design systems or component libraries: brand kits, templates, or asset libraries you built that non-designers genuinely adopted.

 - Range with coherence: evidence of designing across visually distinct domains or audiences while holding a recognizable through-line, plus the ability to work with dense scientific and AI subject matter (LQMs, agentic systems, quantum-era security) and turn complex technical concepts into clear visual designs.

 - Comfort building from scratch and working independently. You have established a brand or web practice where none existed, you use AI tools actively in your workflow, and you can write/present to win support for your ideas.




HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Motion, animation, or interactive web/UI experience.

 - Building interactive, web-native alternatives to static PDFs and decks.

 - Brand or web experience in science, deep tech, healthcare, or other technically demanding fields.

 - Baseline SEO and accessibility literacy.

 - Print and production experience.




WHY JOIN US?

We offer competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

 - Work-Life Balance: Fully remote, Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

 - Career Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and growth through on-the-job development, cross-functional collaboration, and access to internal learning and development programs.




SANDBOXAQ WELCOMES ALL

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and respect, where diverse perspectives are actively sought and valued. Our multidisciplinary environment provides ample opportunity for continuous growth - working alongside humble, empowered, and ambitious colleagues ready to tackle epic challenges.

Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The SandboxAQ AI Generation Engine (SAIGE) team’s mission is to accelerate SandboxAQ’s mission of “Deep Impact at Scale” with a focus on quantitative AI and rapid innovation. More specifically, the SAIGE team aims to:

 - Build next-generation AI capabilities that establish SandboxAQ as the global pacesetter in quantitative AI.

 - Identify, incubate, prototype, and launch new AI products for high-potential and longer-term use cases, proving (or disproving) their viability as high-impact, highly profitable business lines.

The SAIGE team operates on the following principles: Prototype with Velocity, Explore Boldly, Fail Smart, Learn Fast, Look Forward, and Share Knowledge.

Our current top priority use case is leveraging AI and LQMs to solve some of the most impactful problems in the Finance and Insurance industries.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY 

As the Director of Product Management for the AI Generation Engine (SAIGE), you will be the PM lead for the team and a key partner to engineering, research, and user research. You will:

 - Own the product strategy and execution for our efforts in Finance & Risk Modeling, partnering closely with financial services and insurance customers to understand their workflows, risk models, and decision-making processes.

 - Lead rapid prototyping and innovation across a broad range of new ideas and domains, driving 0→1 product discovery, experimentation, and incubation of high-potential use cases.

 - Operate in a highly ambiguous, fast-changing environment, providing clarity on priorities, making pragmatic trade-offs, and ensuring we ship impactful prototypes and products.

This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who is energized by uncertainty, enjoys working across disciplines (UXR, engineering, research, business), and is excited to build new AI and quantitative products from the ground up.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 


LEAD PRODUCT STRATEGY IN FINANCE & RISK MODELING

 - Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for our Finance/Risk portfolio, with a focus on financial services and insurance (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, risk analytics, underwriting, and related workflows).

 - Develop a deep understanding of customer contexts, including current tools, models, and data flows (e.g., portfolio / risk modeling systems, vendor platforms, internal analytics stacks).

 - Partner with quantitative researchers, ML engineers, and domain experts to translate customer problems into clear product requirements and model/data needs.

 - Define success metrics and validation strategies to compare our approaches against existing PML/ERM and portfolio views, and to demonstrate differentiated value.


DRIVE RAPID PROTOTYPING AND 0→1 INNOVATION

 - Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new AI / LQM use cases across multiple domains (beyond Finance/Risk), from early signals to clearer opportunities.

 - Lead 0→1 product discovery: problem framing, hypothesis development, lightweight customer validation, and rapid iteration on prototypes.

 - Work with engineering and research to scope experiments that are small enough to move quickly but meaningful enough to answer key questions.

 - Establish and champion a rigorous but pragmatic approach to ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team focuses on the highest-impact opportunities.


BUILD STRONG CUSTOMER AND STAKEHOLDER RELATIONSHIPS

 - Serve as a trusted product partner to senior stakeholders at key customers (e.g., heads of risk, portfolio managers, actuaries, CROs), speaking credibly about risk models, scenarios, and portfolio decisions.

 - Lead customer conversations from initial discovery through pilot definition and ongoing adoption, connecting customer needs to the SAIGE roadmap.

 - Communicate progress, learnings, and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, including executives.
   
    


ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 

You are a senior product leader who is comfortable at the intersection of AI, quantitative modeling, and financial risk. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working closely with deeply technical teams, and can just as easily go deep on models and data as you can on customer needs and business outcomes. You are proactive, low-ego, and collaborative, and you don’t need rigid structure to have impact.




 - 10+ years of product management experience, with substantial time spent on complex B2B or platform products; at least several years operating at a senior / staff / principal / director level (e.g., L7-equivalent scope).

 - Deep Experience in financial services and/or insurance, especially in one or more of:
   
   - Risk modeling (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, asset-liability management, market/credit risk, or insurance risk)
   
   - Financial simulation or scenario analysis
   
   - Portfolio analytics or decision support tools

 - Demonstrated ability to work closely with quantitative and engineering teams:
   
   - Past experience in building AI / ML products or capabilities
   
   - Comfortable discussing models, data pipelines, and trade-offs with engineers and researchers.
   
   - Able to translate between technical details and customer/business value.

 - Proven track record of 0→1 product work:
   
   - Identifying new opportunities and shaping them from idea to prototype and early product.
   
   - Working through high ambiguity, incomplete information, and changing constraints.

 - Strong ruthless prioritization skills: can define clear frameworks, make hard trade-offs, and say “no” to good ideas to focus on the best ones.

 - Exceptional customer-facing skills:
   
   - Confident leading discovery and roadmap conversations with senior stakeholders.
   
   - Skilled at uncovering real needs behind stated requirements and pressure-testing problem statements.

 - Demonstrated ability to drive execution without heavy process or structure:
   
   - Self-directed, proactive, and comfortable creating structure where needed rather than waiting for it.
   
   - Experience in environments with shifting priorities and evolving strategies.

 - Strong collaboration and communication:
   
   - Experience working tightly with UXR, design, engineering, and research.
   
   - Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Alignment with SandboxAQ values and the SAIGE principles around rapid prototyping, learning, and shared ownership.
   
    


HIGHLY DESIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 

 - Direct experience building products involving AI / ML, foundational models, quantitative models, or LLM/agentic systems.

 - Hands-on exposure to risk tools and vendor platforms (e.g., risk engines, portfolio analytics systems, or modeling platforms used in insurance and financial services).

 - Experience in both:
   
   - A high-growth startup or new product incubation context, and
   
   - A large, complex environment (e.g., Big Tech, major financial institution), giving you a strong sense of how to navigate stakeholders and scale impact.

 - Educational background in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, finance, or similar).

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping the future of quantitative AI, building products with real impact in finance and insurance (and possibly other domains), and leading 0→1 innovation in a highly cross-functional team, we’d love to hear from you.

 


WHY JOIN US?

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and life outside of work.

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

 - Work-Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, company-wide seasonal breaks, and support for flexible work arrangements that enable sustainable performance.

 - Collaborate closely with AI researchers, product managers, and SWEs to translate high-level business objectives into actionable ML development and deployment roadmaps.

 - Champion and enforce exceptional engineering standards for code quality, system efficiency, and security in a prototyping environment

 - Drive technical execution with high autonomy, making critical design and implementation decisions independently

 - BS in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent field of study

 - 8+ years of postgraduate experience in software development

 - Experience developing highly-available, performant, scalable ML systems, including large-scale data processing pipelines.

 - Strong expertise in Python (including the ML stack: PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, NumPy, Pandas)

 - Long, successful history of driving the full ML lifecycle: from initial data exploration and hypothesis testing to architecture, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

 - Deep proficiency in MLOps and software best practices, including CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking (e.g., Weights & Biases, MLflow), automated testing, and version control for both code and datasets.

 - MS or PhD in Software Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent experience

 - Financial simulation or technical experience, risk simulation

 - Equivalent experience includes tech leadership in a complex space, driving technical design and execution cross-collaboratively across multiple teams and organizations

 - Experience with scalable software development on cloud computing platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS)

 - Compensation: Competitive base salary, performance-based incentives or bonuses (where applicable), and equity participation.

 - Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents with generous employer premium contributions, retirement savings with company matching, paid parental leave, and inclusive family-building benefits.

You will work alongside industrial co-development partners to move candidate molecules from prediction to qualified use.



Introduction to the role: The PFAS team is hiring Machine Learning Scientists to own machine learned force fields (MLFFs) for the PFAS substitution programme, including generating the first principles data they are trained on. Machine learned potentials are the load bearing element of our discovery pipeline: the properties that decide whether a candidate molecule can replace a PFAS incumbent — among them reactivity, thermal stability, and the diffusivity through polymer matrices — are ones that the physics based simulations can compute accurately but far too slowly to screen a library, and that classical force fields compute quickly but may not be accurate enough to trust. In this role you will: (1) design and run the high-throughput quantum chemistry and molecular dynamics campaigns that produce our training data, and own the infrastructure that makes them reproducible; (2) train, validate, and deploy the potentials that data supports, and identify where each model's domain of validity ends; and (3) extend machine learned potentials into the chemistry that PFAS substitution requires.

See how SandboxAQ is helping build America's semiconductor supply chain from the materials up https://www.sandboxaq.com/post/sandboxaq-helping-build-americas-semiconductor-supply-chain




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the training data. Design and run high-throughput physics based simulation campaigns that produce labelled training data for the PFAS chemical space, making the calls that determine whether the data is fit to train on — level of theory, basis set, convergence criteria, sampling strategy, and error budget.

 - Build the data generation infrastructure. Stand up automated, restartable, provenance tracked workflows across cloud and HPC by collaborating with the engineering team; curate and version the resulting datasets, and combine internally generated first-principles data with relevant public molecular and materials datasets under consistent conventions.

 - Train and own the MLFF stack for the PFAS vertical. Select architectures, train, validate, and deploy machine learned interatomic potentials across the chemical space of PFAS substitution demands. Fine tuning universal or foundation potentials, or training from scratch when appropriate.

 - Deliver the property predictions the screening pipeline runs on. Build and validate MLFF-driven protocols for the properties our pipelines need — for example protonation and deprotonation energetics underpinning pKa, ion diffusivity in glassy polymer matrices, and Green-Kubo viscosity and thermal conductivity — each benchmarked against reference data or experiment.

 - Push the potentials into the process chemistries that matter. Extend coverage to resin phase polymerisation and plasma surface etch chemistry, moving beyond single molecule, gas phase behaviour into the condensed phase regime our applications actually occupy.

 - Run production campaigns and deploy models on our platform. Execute at scale prediction campaigns across full candidate libraries, and land trained models, datasets, and reproducible training pipelines in SandboxAQ tooling so that other scientists can run them from written documentation.

 - Collaborate across the discovery loop, and set the honesty bar. Partner with the generative modeling, molecular property ML, and simulation teams so that MLFF-derived properties are usable as screening oracles and reward signals. Work with our partner facing materials scientists so predictions are checked against real process constraints. Report error bars, hold-out performance, and domain-of-validity limits alongside every predicted property, and escalate when a model is being asked a question it cannot answer.

 - PhD in Computational Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Machine Learning, or a related field, with deep specialization in machine learned interatomic potentials or atomistic simulation.

 - Demonstrated depth developing and deploying machine learned force fields — including at least one potential that you trained, validated, and put into the hands of other people who now rely on it, whether inside a company or as a public release. We are interested in what you have built and shipped rather than in years served, and this posting is open across experience levels.

 - Hands-on experience generating first principles training data at throughput with production quantum chemistry and electronic structure codes (e.g. VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, ORCA, Psi4, or Gaussian), including the judgment to set and defend level of theory, basis set, and convergence criteria.

 - Demonstrated fluency with descriptor based, modern equivariant, and message-passing potential architectures (e.g. MACE, NequIP, Allegro, TensorNet, DeePMD, ANI-class, or FairChem/UMA-family models) — including what each is good for and where each fails.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and hands on experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, JAX), including training at scale on GPU clusters.

 - Practical experience coupling learned potentials into production molecular dynamics engines (e.g. LAMMPS, GROMACS, OpenMM, ASE) and extracting converged physical observables from the resulting trajectories.

 - Hands-on experience with classical molecular dynamics in those same engines — force field selection and parameterisation for organic and condensed phase systems (e.g. OPLS-AA, AMBER/GAFF, or ReaxFF for reactive chemistry), system construction and equilibration, ensemble and thermostat/barostat choice, and the judgment to say when a classical description stops being trustworthy and a learned potential is required.

 - Experience building automated computational workflows and curating large scientific datasets — provenance, versioning, and reproducibility.

 - Demonstrated validation discipline: a track record of characterising model error and out-of-domain failure rather than reporting best case benchmark numbers.

 - Experience working in cloud and high performance computing environments.

 - Experience computing free energies by thermodynamic cycle or alchemical methods, and/or transport properties by Green-Kubo or non-equilibrium MD.

Introduction to the role: We are looking for a Principal Scientist to lead the scientific direction of the Magnets vertical. This leader will work at the intersection of domain science and platform innovation. You will help shape the magnetism-aware LQM and multi-scale modeling strategy in close partnership with our AI simulation platform teams, while also guiding dataset strategy, modeling priorities, and experimental validation to turn cutting-edge research into practical, manufacturable magnet technologies.

You will also serve as a key external scientific representative for the program, working with national labs, manufacturing partners, defense organizations, and equipment companies.

 - IP Engine Management: Oversee the translation of generative design outputs into a robust IP portfolio, ensuring the team owns the most valuable "white space" in substrate chemistry and structural design.

 - Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of research scientists, computational/ML scientists, and postdocs; set the scientific bar, run technical reviews, and develop talent toward NewCo readiness.
